mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) signals a supportive monetary policy, which encourages investment and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over a month signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 4% YoY) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS increase > 0.5% in 1 month) signals a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 4% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
